content: Internet Archive exposes an Advancedsearch API (archive.org/advancedsearch.php) for query/filter/facet search returning JSON, and a Metadata API (archive.org/metadata/{identifier}) returning full item metadata + file listing in one call. IA auto-generates a per-item '<identifier>_archive.torrent' file with BEP19 HTTP web-seed URLs pointing back at IA's own servers, making IA items usable both as direct HTTP downloads and as legally-seeded torrents — ideal as the bundled default indexer/source.
